en.topic_title: Friends, rights groups worry for Chinese #MeToo activist’s life after jail
en.topic_summary:
Rio once joined his friend, jailed Chinese #MeToo activist Sophia Huang Xueqin, for weekly group discussions on social issues and shared struggles, and now worries about how she will navigate life after prison.



Huang took a series of photos of herself with the hashtag #Metoo and posted them on social media. Photo: Sophia Huang. 



Huang, a journalist, has been behind bars since 2021, when she and labour activist Wang Jianbing were detained for co-organising those meetings, among other charge
